Overall, the deep infiltrative location and mass-effect/edema pattern outweigh the relatively mild enhancement, so the best estimate is IDH-wildtype.

The small enhancing and necrotic components lower certainty, but the corpus-callosal/ventricular deep infiltrative pattern with extensive edema and mass effect favors IDH-wildtype, non-codeleted, CNS WHO grade 4 disease.
